register.matter: First decision paper — Alder Quay Settlement
register.origin_reporter: PD-6834-R, certified by Tess Arnay (m4v7); the executed addition and handover reported separately in h6q3 and r5n8; incumbency reported by Maren Dovell in j8f2.
register.effective: Deed dated 21 October 2022; addition effective 26 March 2026; position at 16:00 BST on 12 June 2026.
register.receipt: All four records in the closed set.
register.finding: May be considered: Ione Berrick, Emmett Vann and Rhea Marden. Payments already authorised: none evidenced; no recorded distribution decision to cite. Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell must exercise discretion over income and capital jointly. No object is entitled before an appointment in that object’s favour.
register.competing_passages_reason: The original list in m4v7 predates the addition and is not a closed list. h6q3 says the instrument does not “remove any Object, appoint any property, direct any payment or alter any other provision of the parent deed.” Neither the office reimbursement nor the meeting booking is a distribution decision.

register.matter: Second decision paper — Flint Orchard Settlement
register.origin_reporter: PD-6894-R, certified by Bram Lerrit (x2c9); incumbency reported by Maren Dovell (j8f2).
register.effective: Deed dated 21 October 2022; position at the 12 June cut-off.
register.receipt: Both records in the closed set.
register.finding: May be considered: Ione Berrick and Orla Penrick. Payments already authorised: none evidenced; no recorded distribution decision to cite. Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell act together over income and capital. They may apply funds directly for an Object’s benefit; eligibility creates no right to payment.
register.competing_passages_reason: The same trustees and Ione appear on the Alder Quay file, but the powers, object lists and decisions are settlement-specific. Clause 8 permits additions by all serving trustees together, without anyone else’s consent; it does not itself add Rhea or Sella. A direct application for an Object’s benefit is not an appointment to a helper in her own right.

register.matter: Identity, execution and delivery of the addition
register.origin_reporter: Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell executed and delivered the original; Della Pennick witnessed each signature in person. Alys Morcant checked the signed-paper transcript (h6q3). Gideon Sarn entered the handover he attended and certified the live-register extract (r5n8).
register.effective: Transcript checked before handover on 26 March 2026; immediate delivery at 11:30 GMT that day. Register extract certified 11 June 2026.
register.receipt: Both evidentiary records in the closed set; the original was placed in the common deed vault, not reported as physically delivered to the adviser.
register.finding: One signed original, SD-Q7M2, delivered jointly against the stated parent PD-6834-R. The custodian memorialised the trustees’ choice; he neither chose the trust nor designated Rhea.
register.competing_passages_reason: h6q3 expressly says its certificate does not attest to delivery. r5n8 reports delivery but does not name the object. The two records concern the same paper but prove different facts; neither is a second independent proof of the whole addition.

register.matter: Claim that SD-Q7M2 adds Rhea Marden to Flint Orchard Settlement, or to both settlements
register.origin_reporter: Possible reading of the unnamed parent in h6q3 alone; tested against Gideon Sarn’s handover entry and the two certified parent deeds.
register.receipt: h6q3, r5n8, m4v7 and x2c9 all in the closed set.
register.finding: Withhold [Rhea Marden, beneficiary_of, Flint Orchard Settlement]. Before identification at delivery either trust could fit the signatories and the form of power. The actual complete parent field is PD-6834-R (Alder Quay), not PD-6894-R (Flint Orchard).
register.competing_passages_reason: There is no unreadable character in either reference in this entry. The general question-mark convention creates no alternative here. The shared-stock label alone identifies no trust, and one original is not evidence of a counterpart for the other trust. This rules out Flint Orchard as the parent of this instrument, not every conceivable later or unfiled instrument.

register.matter: Preparation is not authorisation; completeness beyond this packet
register.origin_reporter: Maren Dovell’s 12 June preparation note (j8f2); the deeds’ joint decision requirements; no distribution minute or payment instruction supplied.
register.effective: Preparation cut-off 16:00 BST on 12 June 2026; one booked slot on 17 June.
register.receipt: j8f2 and the two selected extracts in the closed set; no later papers admitted.
register.finding: Prepare separate working papers and minute entries, Alder Quay first. Keep ordinary finance queries separate and send late papers separately to the meeting. The assertion that the note authorises a payment is explicitly contradicted by “This note authorises no payment.”
register.competing_passages_reason: A request to list recorded decisions is not itself a recorded decision. Both deeds are extracts, with schedules omitted, and both specify England and Wales law. The file supports a report of no evidenced authorisation, not a finding that no appointment has ever been made.

register.matter: Travel estimate and scope of Sella Quist’s authority
register.origin_reporter: Ione Berrick’s own letter to Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell (b9k4).
register.effective: 18 February, as dated in the letter; no year stated there.
register.receipt: Letter held by cut-off; no replacement estimate supplied in the closed set.
register.finding: Ione reported that the old estimate was unreliable and the replacement had not arrived. Sella helps with envelopes and chasing papers and may pass on the replacement estimate. Ione offers to sign confirmations herself.
register.competing_passages_reason: Permission to forward an estimate is not authority to sign for Ione, decide for the trustees or receive trust money. The letter does not select a paying settlement. Whether an updated estimate is now available and what amount it supports remain unresolved.

register.matter: Possible assistance to Sella Quist in her own right
register.origin_reporter: Ione Berrick’s request in b9k4, prompted by Sella turning down shifts; compared with the two deeds and the actual designation.
register.effective: Requested on 18 February; no operative addition or appointment for Sella shown by cut-off.
register.receipt: Request, extracts and Rhea designation all in the closed set.
register.finding: Whether the trustees wish and are able to assist Sella in her own right is a question, not a decision. Withhold Sella Quist as beneficiary of either settlement. If an addition is proposed, identify the particular trust, confirm the person qualifies and use that deed’s joint execution and delivery requirements; a distribution would still need a separate exercise of discretion.
register.competing_passages_reason: Ione asks “Would you consider whether you can help her in her own right, if you think that’s appropriate?” She expressly disclaims asking for a standing payment, redirection of money meant for her, or deduction from her payment. Treating the letter as any of those requests is explicitly contradicted. The executed designation names Rhea, not Sella; the EX-K4 payee entry has a different purpose.

register.matter: Ordinary finance, outside both decision papers — EX-K4 postage
register.origin_reporter: Sella Quist’s claim for getting Ione’s papers to the office; Una Cresset’s reconciliation to the operating account and attached postage slip (t3w6).
register.effective: Reimbursement matched on 5 June; reconciliation dated 11 June.
register.receipt: Reconciliation in the closed set; postage slip reported attached to the claim.
register.finding: £12.60 postage reimbursed from the office operating account. Neither expense item was recharged. Sella is payee and queries contact for EX-K4 only.
register.competing_passages_reason: Ione’s expectation of separate expense accounting in b9k4 is consistent with the reconciliation, not authority for reimbursement or a trust distribution. The specific account match and no-recharge statement contradict treating this entry as a payment from either settlement.

register.matter: Ordinary finance query — EX-K4 print-shop charges
register.origin_reporter: Sella Quist’s £8.40 claim; Una Cresset’s expense list, voucher check and reconciliation (t3w6).
register.effective: 11 June reconciliation, still the finance record at cut-off.
register.receipt: Reconciliation received; the office did not receive the referenced receipt and holds no copy or substitute voucher.
register.finding: Whether £8.40 can be substantiated for reimbursement remains open. That it is unpaid and not an authorised balance is supported; a claim that it is an approved amount due is explicitly contradicted.
register.competing_passages_reason: A list referring to a receipt is not the receipt. Una reports no distribution instruction. Do not combine the two expense amounts into a distribution, outstanding balance or deduction from Ione.

source_audit.audit: Maren Dovell, Meeting Secretary, reports the appointments book for both settlements and names the serving pair. It supports four current trustee edges and continuity for the March exercise of power. The book itself is not a second supplied copy. The secretary’s own preparation instructions, booking and cut-off establish neither a distribution nor a new appointment to office.

Tess Arnay, deed-records clerk, certified selected clauses to adviser Kit Wenslow on 9 June 2026 against the lodged Alder Quay deed. One deed origin, not independent evidence from an original and its extract. Supports Ellis, Ione and Emmett directly; names Nell and Tobin as original trustees. Supplies the exact parent map, exclusions, unanimity and delivery power for Rhea, but neither names her nor records delivery.

Bram Lerrit, deed-records clerk, certified Flint Orchard’s own extract to Kit Wenslow on 9 June 2026. Supports Cora, Ione and Orla directly and identifies both original trustees. Its PD-6894-R and clause 8 test the competing parent reading. The similar date and provisions are from a different deed, not duplicate proof of an Alder Quay relationship.

Alys Morcant, signing-room clerk, reports the signed instrument, including the two signatures witnessed by Della Pennick, records assistant. A transcript and the execution text it reproduces share one origin. The transcript establishes operative wording, identity of the additional object and execution, not parent identity, delivery, a removal or a payment. Neither clerk nor witness is made a trustee by that work.

Gideon Sarn, Merefold custody officer, certified one entry only. The entry derives from the trustees’ joint handover, independently of a title search or beneficiary file. The extract is a copy of that entry, not a second handover witness. It binds the exact instrument to the exact parent at immediate delivery, but supplies no beneficiary name or independent designation and no June appointments-book evidence.

Ione’s first-person correspondence supports her request, estimate status as then known and narrow permission to Sella. Addressing Nell and Tobin is not an independent statement of their office in a named trust. The letter does not prove Ione’s own object status, add Sella, establish kinship or authorise any payment.

Una Cresset, Accounts Administrator, reports EX-K4, with one operating-account match and one missing voucher. The payee field has an expressly limited scope. No scored relationship follows from a claim, contact role, expense or reimbursement. Across the file there is no explicit parent, sibling or spouse relationship, and no basis to transpose Emmett and Orla between the trusts.

For Flint Orchard, do the full lodged deed PD-6894-R, omitted schedules and any further deeds confirm Ione Berrick and Orla Penrick? Check Flint Orchard’s own minutes, direct applications and payments rather than importing an Alder Quay decision.

For each decision, will Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell confirm continuing authority and record their joint decision, identifying the settlement, object, purpose, amount and any prior decision or payment to which it relates?

Has Ione supplied a reliable replacement travel estimate and confirmed the need and proposed use herself? If it arrives after cut-off, send it separately; do not substitute the old estimate or treat Sella’s forwarding role as wider authority.

Is the proposal assistance for Ione’s benefit or separate assistance for Sella in her own right? If the latter is pursued, which settlement and deed power are proposed, and what qualification checks, deed of addition and subsequent distribution decision would be required?

Separately for accounts: can Sella supply the missing £8.40 print-shop receipt or acceptable substitute for EX-K4? Leave it queried, distinguish it from the reimbursed £12.60, and do not charge either settlement on this record.
